name: cynic-proof-of-history
description: The immutable nervous system and data pipeline for CYNIC events

stages.name: raw_data
stages.description: Unstructured or raw output from sensors, APIs, or LLM output before validation.

stages.name: data_warehouse
stages.description: Append-only sink. Every event, decision, and anomaly is recorded here chronologically.

stages.name: jsonl_datasets
stages.description: Curated, filtered, or domain-specific subsets derived from the warehouse for ML inference or replay.

stages.name: surrealdb
stages.description: Live queryable state. Synced from the warehouse. Organs query this for real-time decision making.

stages.name: CCM
stages.description: Cynic Coordination Model. The execution layer that consumes the live state and emits new raw data (actions).
